title: Inspect and extend: Validate a pledge without moving money
objective: Use the real implementation in `Sources/Core.swift` to demonstrate and safely improve pledge validation, status changes, detail state, and progress display.
problem: A pledge form can validate an amount and update a demo model. Trace input through the rule method and back to the detail screen. This models workflow only; it never calls a payment processor. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `Sources/Core.swift` and the related project files: Sources/Core.swift; Sources/Screens/ProjectDetailView.swift; Tests/ProjectCoreTests.swift.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to pledge validation, status changes, detail state, and progress display.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: No charge, payment authorization, or server-side pledge is performed.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A pledge form can validate an amount and update a demo model. Trace input through the rule method and back to the detail screen. This models workflow only; it never calls a payment processor.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `Sources/Core.swift`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
